added.content: Damon's London-opening problem - losing the thread by move 15 - resolved into an actual plan: f4/Rf3/Rh3 kingside attack when they won't trade, c3 against early c5, Qb3 against Qb6. Then the real find: he's better in endgames than middlegames, so forcing queen trades is the plan and the attack is just cover for when they refuse. "Huh. yeah. that's actually the thing." Committed to ten games to test it. [sess-2026-10-13_3a4b5c6d:13-60]
